question: How many artworks are in the museum sample? Return one count.
How many artworks have a populated artist name? NULL, empty, and whitespace-only names are missing. Return one count.
How many artworks have a missing artist name? Include NULL, empty, and whitespace-only names. Return one count.
How many artworks are explicitly marked as public domain? Return one count.
How many artworks have a populated primary image URL? NULL, empty, and whitespace-only URLs are missing. Return one count.
How many artworks have no populated primary image URL? Include NULL, empty, and whitespace-only URLs. Return one count.
How many artworks belong to the Asian Art department? Return one count.
How many artworks have a populated classification? NULL, empty, and whitespace-only classifications are missing. Return one count.
Return object ID and title for the five artworks with the smallest object IDs, in ascending ID order.
How many artworks have a populated culture? NULL, empty, and whitespace-only culture values are missing. Return one count.
Return every department and its artwork count, sorted by department name ascending.
For each department with public-domain artworks, return department and public-domain artwork count, sorted by department ascending.
For each department with missing artist names, return department and that count, sorted by department ascending. NULL, empty, and whitespace-only artist names are missing.
For each department with populated primary image URLs, return department and that count, sorted by department ascending. NULL, empty, and whitespace-only URLs are missing.
How many public-domain artworks are classified exactly as Paintings? Return one count.
How many Asian Art artworks have a populated culture? NULL, empty, and whitespace-only cultures are missing. Return one count.
How many artworks with a populated primary image URL are not explicitly marked public domain? NULL, empty, and whitespace-only URLs are missing. Return one count.
Return the five departments with the most artworks as department and count, sorted by count descending, then department ascending for ties.
Return object ID, title, and department for the five public-domain artworks with the smallest object IDs, sorted by ID ascending.

For each department with populated classifications, return department and the number of distinct populated classifications, sorted by department ascending. NULL, empty, and whitespace-only classifications are missing.
How many sculptures are in the sample under the supplied category mapping? Return one count.
For each department with mapped sculptures, return department and sculpture count, sorted by department ascending.
How many mapped sculptures are explicitly marked public domain? Return one count.
How many mapped sculptures have a trimmed classification other than the exact label Sculpture? Return one count.
How many sample objects have unknown sculpture membership because classification is NULL, empty, or whitespace-only? Return one count.
How many sample objects have a populated classification outside the supplied sculpture mapping? Count these as unmapped, without asserting that they are not sculptures. Return one count.
